notes.title: Patch 1.17
notes.content:
[b]Balance[/b]
Increased the amount of magic you get from mind by 33%. 
Changed the place of some of the masochism skills so that you don't start off with only defensive skills.
Finally fixed the item drop-rates. Now all items will be available on the drop table once you reach the end-game. 

[b]Quality[/b]
Added a list of controls to the main-menu. 
Added an in-combat stats-screen that shows up while tab is held down.
Added a combat icon for the sway stat. 

[b]New content[/b]
Added a new interactive event for when you give a blowjob to the devil enemy. (some people were redoing the devil event to collect huge amounts of loot. Now there will be a skill-check in place to make it more in line with other events with big rewards)
Added a new weapon.

notes.title: Patch 1.15
notes.content: [p]Returned to 1.14 but without the brewing bug.[/p][p]fixed a bug where the passive skills "animalistic" and "warrior spririt" had the opposite effect of what was advertised in their description. [/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.14 > Event Gallery
notes.content:
[p][b]New features[/b][/p][p]Added a gallery that allows you to replay events from dungeons that you’ve already beaten. [/p][p]
[/p][p][b]QoL changes[/b][/p][p]Added a hover-over menu to the brewing scene so that you can read the effect of skills without exiting the scene. [/p][p]Increased the randomness of the randomizer to avoid statistical patterns showing up when players run dungeons 100s of times. [/p][p]Allies will now prioritize enemies that fight back and ignore charmed enemies if they have other targets. [/p][p]Your in battle portrait will now sparkle at the start of your turn, making it more obvious you’re active.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Bugfixes[/b][/p][p]Fixed a bug where you could try to enchant level 0 items, resulting in null enchantments. [/p][p]Fixed a bug where some level 0 items would be purchasable in the store. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45670675/a2cc8c6b6c6479a8edcf7b121bf32ec3fb079726.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.13
notes.content: Added a game_ID override. Hoping it might fix the linux bug Flah32000 was having.

notes.title: Patch 1.12
notes.content:
Edited the hair sprite to stop clipping with some hats.
Fixed a bug where the main character's gear would flicker for a frame when opening the stats menu. 
Reduced the delay for when a hover-over tool-tip shows up in combat.
Made it more obvious in combat if a character is cursed. 

Added 1 new achievement.
